one_liner: Create, manage, and measure ad campaigns across Meta platforms programmatically
blocker: App Review approval required for advanced access (managing other people's ad accounts) and Full tier; default Limited tier is dev-only and heavily rate-limited

evidence.claim: Every Marketing API call is authenticated with an access token (OAuth2 user tokens or system user tokens).
evidence.quote: Every Marketing API call requires an access token as a parameter.

evidence.claim: Free self-serve developer access: Limited tier is granted automatically on adding the Marketing API product to an app.
evidence.quote: Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app.

evidence.claim: Managing other people's ad accounts requires Meta App Review for advanced access to ads_read/ads_management.
evidence.quote: If your app is managing other people’s ad accounts, you need advanced access to the`ads_read` and/or`ads_management` permissions.

evidence.claim: The Marketing API is a REST-style Graph API surface covering campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, audiences, insights, and more.
evidence.quote: The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints and other features that can be used to help you advertise across Meta technologies.

evidence.claim: Meta launched an official hosted MCP server for ads (mcp.facebook.com/ads) on 29 April 2026, per third-party coverage of Meta's announcement.
evidence.quote: is Meta's official Ads AI Connectors MCP endpoint, launched 29 April 2026

notes: Official MCP/CLI evidence comes from third-party blogs citing Meta's April 29, 2026 'AI Connectors' launch, not Meta docs supplied here. Access tiers were relabeled: Standard->Limited, Advanced->Full; Full tier needs 500+ Marketing API calls in past 15 days and <15% error rate. System user tokens do not expire, suiting server-to-server use. Running live campaigns requires an active ad account with billing. Standard access suffices for an app managing only its own ad account.
